change_summary: Prepare immutable 1.7.98 distribution for retained-image/audio references and composed producer/consumer coverage. Preserve API download, ACL, transcription and the existing collaboration revision; publication and website/GitHub version/hash readback remain release-owned evidence.

canonical_skill.note: The retained-media reference module consumes copyable document_image/document_audio Markdown and explains independent reader-access, codec and transcription boundaries. Existing entry guidance/freshness authority remain unchanged; the shared review digest is refreshed before sealing.

server_contract.note: Add typed document_image/document_audio and shared authoring guidance. API download links retain their previous meaning; package version promotion and production publication are not claimed by this candidate. Align the current backend freshness version with the canonical 1.7.98 source manifest; current-version fixtures remain independently checked against source package bytes.

package_manifests.note: The release assembly advances every package envelope together to 1.7.98 because retained-media reference bytes changed. The collaboration revision and minimum compatibility remain unchanged; version preparation is not publication. Both static MCP release headers carry the same source version; transport-reported facts remain distinct from installed-byte proof.

workspace_cli.note: No CLI code or version change in this candidate: files receipts and docs authoring-contract already consume the additive shared server response. Existing reviewed-version/default-alias authority stays unchanged.

help_center.note: The existing Help reference route reads canonical documents.md; the image-reference guidance therefore ships with application deployment, without a separate duplicated Help body.

package_setup.note: Only the SessionStart release projection advances to 1.7.98. Activation, consent, learning, source handling and continuation prose remain unchanged; source parity does not prove a Host loaded the Hook.

harness_and_mainline.note: Image reference mainlines and the logbook preserve byte identity, current ACL and API/browser transport boundaries. Production Prompt and the existing package-freshness story stay unchanged.

external_marketplaces.note: Future package publication and fresh-host Marketplace discovery remain release-owned gates; this candidate claims neither.

public_release_assets.note: The unchanged canonical builder regenerates immutable archives from updated references and 1.7.98 release metadata. Protected publication must read back website/GitHub version and hashes; no artificial builder code change is required.

release_evidence.note: The same actual MCP PNG/WAV carrier and bytes enter Chromium decoding/retry/reload tests, plus storage, ACL and persistence countercases. Independent navigation baseline failures remain visible; live Azure PUT, Claude provider-live and deployment remain unverified. Actual generated package parity and backend freshness tests bind current source version rather than historical literals; prior failed preflights remain preserved.
